[[Feather]]s are a common crafting material used in armor and weapon crafting. They are almost exclusively obtained as [[drop]]s from [[griffon]]s, [[harpy|harpies]] and [[tengu]]s and from salvaging their [[trophy|trophies]].

==Acquisition==
* Purchased from [[material trader]]s.
* [[Salvage Kit|Salvaged]] from:
** Armor crafted with Feathers (see below).
** See [[:Category:Contains feather]] for other items.
* For known [[creature]]s that [[drop]] Feathers see [[:Category:Drops feather]].
